channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Our Opinion: Remembering bravery, sacrifice of Pearl Harbor
item.description: Eighty-four years after Pearl Harbor, reflections on the attack highlight American unity, sacrifice and the enduring bravery of those who responded, as seen in editorials from The Wilson Times.

item.title: Frozen aid, Gaza shivers and a peace deal melts away
item.description: Despite a ceasefire deal, Gaza faces a worsening humanitarian crisis as winter sets in, with most aid blocked, shelter needs unmet and children at risk from cold, hunger and inadequate relief.

item.title: You need to understand the Supreme Court’s ‘shadow docket’
item.description: The Supreme Court’s “shadow docket” allows conservative justices to make major decisions without full hearings or explanations, often favoring Trump and undermining lower court rulings and democratic norms.

item.title: Black Friday despite? No, Black Friday because
item.description: Amid economic uncertainty, Americans set new Black Friday and Thanksgiving online sales records, reflecting a shift toward waiting for major deals as shoppers grow more cautious with their spending.

item.title: When the legislature can’t pass a budget, it’s time to reassess priorities
item.description: North Carolina lawmakers failed to pass a state budget this year, raising concerns about governance, disrupting public services and threatening the Republican reputation for fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Youth mental well-being book project expands to Wilson County Schools through Rotary partnership
item.description: Wilson County Schools, in partnership with local Rotary clubs, is distributing “The Rotary Mindset” journals to students, aiming to boost youth mental well-being with daily reflection tools and proactive support.

item.title: Alleged accomplice receives bond in murder case
item.description: Alicia Marie Nieves received a $75,000 secured bond on accessory charges in connection with the Nov. 29 murder of Kenneth Ray Finch Jr. Her probable cause hearing is set for Dec. 19.

item.title: Man, woman charged in cemetery robbery
item.description: A Wilson man and a Rocky Mount woman face robbery and assault charges after police say they attacked and robbed a woman at Maplewood Cemetery.

item.title: Boykin retiring as police chief in February
item.description: Wilson Police Chief Benny Boykin will retire Feb. 1 after 28 years with the department. City officials will begin searching for his successor as department majors oversee operations during the transition.

item.title: Defense fuels Fike’s fast start in 68-59 victory against Rose
item.description: Fike High’s boys basketball team used a dominant first-quarter defense to secure a 68-59 home win over J.H. Rose, with Daquavis Greene leading the Demons with 16 points and Jayonta Blanchard adding 15.
